tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Previous Supply Experience : The firm should have supplied the minimum 300 Metric Tons for any of the STUs or the organizations during previous financial year (From April-2025 to March-2026). They should furnish the invoice copies in support of the same. (Statement - 01 and invoice copies to be uploaded)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Statement - 01 and invoice copies to be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: ISO Certification : The firm should have ISO 9001-2015 or latest certification. They should submit the proof for the same along with the tender documents.

Production and supply capacity/ Infrastructure facility : The tenderer should offer minimum of 100 MTs per month supply capacity and the firm should have the required machineries and facilities to manufacture PCTR and Allied Materials under one roof/ compound (Declaration-IV to be uploaded as per the format).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Declaration-IV to be uploaded as per the format

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Procurement of Natural Rubber and Rubber Board License : The firm should procure their requirement of natural rubber from the Rubber Board identified sources only (Supporting documents like tax invoice copies to be uploaded). The firm should have valid Rubber Board License. The successful bidder should send Batch Test Certificate to the consignee for every supplies. The undertaking to be furnished by the bidder in this regard during submission of bid (in Declaration-I).

Any bidder from a country which shares a land border with India will be eligible to bid in the tender only if the bidder is registered with the Competent Authority (as detailed at Annexure-B2). In this regard, a compliance certificate/ declaration to be submitted by the bidder on Rs. 20/- & above stamp Paper as per the format at Declaration-III (regarding restrictions on public procurements from bidders of such country/ countries which shares a Land Border with India.)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Declaration III to be submited

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: i) The bidder should undertake to supply the ordered quantity as per the delivery schedule provided. ii) The Tender must fulfill all the statutory requirements. iii) Tenderer who have been blacklisted by any of the Government Organization/ Public Sector undertaking for breach of contract shall not be considered.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Declaration I to be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Turnover : I. Only Manufacturers of all the three items viz. Pre-cured Tread Rubber, Bonding/ Cushion Gum and Black Vulcanizing Cement / Universal Spray Compound with a Minimum Annual Average turn-over of Rs. 30.00 Crores from the sale of PCTR and allied materials for preceding continuous three years (2023-24, 2024-25& 2025-26) are eligible to participate. II. Turnover shall be supported by the audited statements of accounts, i.e., manufacturing, profit & loss accounts, balance sheets. The tenderer should submit audited statements of accounts in original duly signed by the Chartered Accountant along with the prequalification offer. III. The bidder should be manufacturer of all the three items and quote for all the three items viz., Pre-cured tread rubber, Bonding/cushion gum & Black vulcanizing cement/ Universal spray compound. The offers of the firm who are not the manufacturer of all the three items or who have not quoted for all the three items will be disqualified. IV. The tenderer should enclose certificate from the CA along with the membership number, UDIN Number stating that the turnover details furnished in the audited statement of accounts have been verified by him and that they are found correct. Failed to comply with this condition, the offer will be disqualified.

In addition to the audited statement of account, the tenderer should submit Annual GST return acknowledged by the concerned Tax Authority along with the pre-qualification offer for all the three years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual GST return acknowledged by the concerned Tax Authority along with the pre-qualification offer for all the three years
